about.title: Japan in one place in Považská Bystrica
paragraphs: Japan Day of Tea and Culture takes place in Považská Bystrica on 7 November 2026. The event brings together Japanese gastronomy, tea, traditional arts, samurai culture, martial arts, talks and exhibitions.

The event will take place on 7 November at the House of Culture in Považská Bystrica. We will use the main hall as well as the puppet theatre, creating space for performances, presentations, Japanese products and tastings.
Throughout the day you can meet people who have dedicated themselves to Japan for many years, taste authentic food and teas, and experience Japanese culture up close.

faq.question: When is Japan Day of Tea and Culture?
faq.answer: On Saturday, 7 November 2026. The exact opening time and detailed schedule will be announced.

faq.question: Where does the event take place?
faq.answer: At the House of Culture in Považská Bystrica. The programme will use both the main hall and the puppet theatre.

speechContest.title: Japanese Speech Contest & Prize Draw
speechContest.intro: Do you love Japanese or are you just learning it? The Japanese Speech Contest & Prize Draw will take place in Bratislava, with categories for beginners, lower-intermediate and advanced learners.
speechContest.admission: Taking part in the contest is free. Visitors can also look forward to small gifts and a prize draw.
speechContest.organizer: The event is organised by J-Pad.eu s. r. o. under the leadership of Hisayo Yasuda, who is also part of the programme of Japan Day in Považská Bystrica.
